title: Ace's Tweaks
description: Lower Fire, Lower Shield, No Pumpkin Overlay & Colored Ping Indicator
body:
Ace's Tweaks is a lightweight Minecraft resource pack focused on improving visibility and overall gameplay while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style intact. The pack combines several PvP and quality-of-life tweaks into one clean and performance-friendly package.

# Features:

### Lower Fire
![Lower Fire](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f78d04091db8bc7d7b89eb6b151b774dbe8191dc.gif)

### Lower Shield

![No Pumpkin Overlay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/92b2f6d9d01213698bfe7ac3988e02db6b5934c7.gif)

### Colored Ping Indicator
![Colored Ping Indicator](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/256cc52ff3dea9fadaf14642e6b5243ee0611885.png)

## Compatibility
- Java Edition 1.20+
- Bedrock Edition support coming soon

## Help

<details>
<summary>Installation</summary>

1. Download the latest release.
2. Open Minecraft and navigate to Options → Resource Packs.
3. Click Open Pack Folder.
4. Move the downloaded `.zip` file into the folder.
5. Enable **Ace's Tweaks** in the Resource Packs menu.

</details>
